OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope of the connector, i.e. the entity types it imports.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: Time to wait between two runs, as an ISO 8601 duration. The feed is rebuilt once a day; an unchanged bundle is skipped.

OFFSEQ_MIRAGE_FEED_URL.description: URL of the Mirage Feed STIX 2.1 bundle.

OFFSEQ_MIRAGE_IMPORT_RELATIONSHIPS.description: Import the ATT&CK techniques and CVEs each indicator is linked to, with `indicates` and `related-to` relationships.

OFFSEQ_MIRAGE_CREATE_OBSERVABLES.description: Create the observable behind each indicator, with a `based-on` relationship.

OFFSEQ_MIRAGE_TLP_LEVEL.description: TLP marking applied to every object this connector creates. The feed is published as TLP:CLEAR.

OFFSEQ_MIRAGE_BATCH_SIZE.description: Indicators per bundle sent to OpenCTI.
